blocks.orig: Mbali Mbali Mahale is located deep in the heart of Tanzania on a secluded golden sand beach. Here, at the edge of the Mahale Mountains National Park this lodge offers 10 modernly furnished beach tents strategically placed on the edge of the cooling forest of Mahale and Lake Tanganyika. All rooms are located on raised platforms under thatched roofs and feature a private terrace overlooking Lake Tanganyika and the beach, close to the main lounge and dining areas. They are equipped with comfy beds, luxurious bedding and a full bathroom with an indoor rain shower and double vanity. The surroundings of the lodge are impressive with birds, monkeys, small carnivores and butterflies that allow for an impressive walk through the woods.
blocks.html: Mbali Mbali Mahale sits deep in the heart of Tanzania, on a secluded beach of golden sand. On the edge of the Mahale Mountains National Park, the lodge has 10 beach tents with modern furnishings, carefully positioned where the cool Mahale forest meets Lake Tanganyika. Every room stands on a raised platform beneath a thatched roof and has its own terrace looking out over Lake Tanganyika and the beach, close to the main lounge and dining areas. Inside you find comfortable beds, luxurious linen and a full bathroom with an indoor rain shower and a double vanity. The area around the lodge is impressive, with birds, monkeys, small carnivores and butterflies that make a walk through the woods a memorable experience.
